segment_contamination_dimensions: Home/hobby/ornamental greenhouse buyers (Mini Greenhouse sibling, ID 116157) — buyers seeking small decorative or indoor plant enclosures, not commercial farm-scale protected cultivation structures; names such as 'mini greenhouse', 'indoor greenhouse', 'balcony greenhouse', or 'hobby greenhouse' are blocked as they attract a non-agricultural, non-commercial buyer persona incompatible with this MCAT's farmer and agri-entrepreneur segment.

Generic non-agricultural prefabricated structure buyers (Greenhouse sibling ID 29816, Greenhouse Structure sibling ID 158767, Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse sibling ID 166277) — these sibling MCATs carve out greenhouse types without the agricultural/horticulture qualifier; enhanced names and alt names must retain the 'agricultural' or crop/farming context anchor to avoid overlap with ornamental, research, or non-farm greenhouse buyers.

Polyhouse as standalone structure category (Polyhouse sibling ID 149713) — this sibling carves out the polyhouse sub-type directly; the root MCAT's names must not reduce to bare 'Polyhouse' alone (which would collide with the sibling name) but must carry the agricultural/farming qualifier or broader protected-cultivation framing.

Mist Chamber buyers (Mist Chamber sibling ID 160350) — buyers seeking propagation-specific high-humidity chambers are a distinct sub-segment; names narrowly targeting mist chambers or propagation houses are blocked to avoid contaminating this sibling's buyer segment.
